report:
Baseline: I verified exact byte equality of current structs.rs and semantic_spec.rs against the historical input snapshots. The supplied historical rationale is a substantive deferred-coverage review; the assessment below independently checks current fragments and the complete associated set.

Claim: each generic parameter or associated-item identity has one owning minting query; dependent queries reuse that identity rather than rebuilding it from spelling or position. The captured linked RFD qualifies the identity family: definitions have kind-specific symbols, generic parameters have GenericParam identities, fields have owner/index identities and locals have body-local IDs. Uniformity does not require converting all these to Symbol.

Fresh source evidence: the sole ordinary implementation association is LocalStructSym::sig in structs.rs. It invokes generics.check with this struct as parent and places its returned parameters in the signature binder. The captured CheckGenerics implementation constructs each type/lifetime/const parameter once per owning signature computation with parent and ordinal context. LocalStructSym::fields obtains sig().iter_symbols() and installs those parameters in scope instead of calling generics.check again. This is a concrete owning-signature/dependent-fields example, not proof of all owners, associated items, or edit stability.

The complete test set contains only sage_meta::todo::checking_identity_minting. Its empty body has no behavioral assertions and cannot detect accidental reminting. Its explicit TODO accounts for the remaining verification matrix: cross-query and persistent-edit comparisons of owner, generic-parameter, Self and associated-item identities across signatures, field/member details and bodies, including shadowed equal names. Prerequisites for completing that deferral are suitable persistent-database edit fixtures and access to those identities across the relevant queries, with equality assertions for reused identities and distinctness assertions for different owners/shadowed names. Thus the broad single-minting guarantee remains unverified beyond the inspected example; accepting the existing explicit deferral does not certify complete implementation or tests. No N/A entries exist and no additional edit is required for this accounting.

Execution: I ran review start, review read and the exact-source comparison, then review record. One out-of-bounds helper read was rejected and corrected to lines 95–132. I ran no behavioral tests or workspace build; the coordinator-reported 321 passing tests and root build are separate execution evidence, not verification performed by me.
